# Yuno Docs

> Yuno is a payment orchestration platform. Use these docs to accept payments in many countries with one integration.

## Quick links

- [Quickstart](https://docs.y.uno/docs/quickstart): Accept your first sandbox payment in 10 minutes
- [Yuno SDK](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/get-started): One SDK for Web, iOS and Android
- [API reference](https://docs.y.uno/reference/getting-started/api-reference-overview): Endpoints, authentication, response codes
- [OpenAPI spec (JSON)](https://docs.y.uno/openapi.json): Full API specification
- [OpenAPI spec (YAML)](https://docs.y.uno/openapi.yaml): Full API specification

## Getting started

- [What is Yuno?](https://docs.y.uno/docs/how-yuno-works/what-is-yuno): How Yuno connects you to payment providers worldwide
- [Quickstart](https://docs.y.uno/docs/quickstart): Create a connection, send a test payment, see it in the Dashboard
- [Go live](https://docs.y.uno/docs/go-live): Checklist before your first production payment
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.y.uno/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and how to fix them

## Yuno SDK

- [Get started](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/get-started): Install, show payment methods, take the payment, verify
- [How a transaction flows](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/how-a-transaction-flows): From checkout session to payment confirmation
- [Payment methods list](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/payment-methods-list): Show available methods to your shopper
- [Secure Fields](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/secure-fields): PCI-compliant card input fields
- [Enrollment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/enrollment): Save cards for later
- [Styling](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/features/styling): Customize the SDK appearance
- [Controllers](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/controllers/overview): Override SDK behavior
- [SDK reference](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/reference/objects-you-pass): Objects you pass to and receive from the SDK

## Direct API

- [Direct integration](https://docs.y.uno/docs/direct-integration-use-cases/direct-flow): Run payments from your backend
- [Create payment](https://docs.y.uno/reference/payments/create-payment): POST /v1/payments
- [Retrieve payment](https://docs.y.uno/reference/payments/retrieve-payment-by-id-v2): GET /v1/payments/{id}
- [Refund payment](https://docs.y.uno/reference/payments/refund-payment): POST /v1/payments/{id}/refund
- [Capture payment](https://docs.y.uno/docs/direct-integration-use-cases/capture-payments): Capture an authorized payment

## Dashboard

- [Connections](https://docs.y.uno/docs/using-yuno/dashboard-overview/connections): Add providers, processors and fraud tools
- [Routing](https://docs.y.uno/docs/using-yuno/dashboard-overview/routing): Decide which provider gets each payment
- [Checkout Builder](https://docs.y.uno/docs/using-yuno/dashboard-overview/checkout-builder): Configure which methods show and when
- [Credentials](https://docs.y.uno/docs/using-yuno/settings/developers-credentials): API keys and settings

## Webhooks

- [Configure webhooks](https://docs.y.uno/docs/webhooks/configure-webhooks): Set up your endpoint
- [Events](https://docs.y.uno/docs/webhooks/events): List of webhook event types
- [Verify signatures](https://docs.y.uno/docs/webhooks/verify-webhook-signatures-hmac): HMAC signature verification

## Testing

- [Test Payment Gateway](https://docs.y.uno/docs/direct-integration-use-cases/yuno-testing-gateway): Test cards and scenarios
- [3DS testing](https://docs.y.uno/docs/direct-integration-use-cases/3ds-configuration-and-testing): Configure and test 3D Secure

## Payment features

- [Subscriptions](https://docs.y.uno/docs/payment-features/subscriptions/index): Recurring payments
- [Installments](https://docs.y.uno/docs/payment-features/installments/index): Split payments over time
- [Split payments](https://docs.y.uno/docs/payment-features/split-payments-marketplace): Marketplace payouts

## Wallets

- [Apple Pay](https://docs.y.uno/docs/wallets/apple-pay/prerequisites-apple-pay): Accept Apple Pay
- [Google Pay](https://docs.y.uno/docs/wallets/google-pay/google-pay-sdk-integration): Accept Google Pay
- [PayPal](https://docs.y.uno/docs/wallets/paypal): Accept PayPal

## Security

- [3D Secure](https://docs.y.uno/docs/security-and-compliance/3d-secure): Card authentication
- [PCI compliance](https://docs.y.uno/docs/security-and-compliance/pci-compliance): Handle card data securely
- [Network tokens](https://docs.y.uno/docs/security-and-compliance/network-tokens): Improve authorization rates

## AI integration

- [MCP server](https://docs.y.uno/setup-mcp): Connect the Yuno docs to your coding agent
- [Build with AI](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/build-with-ai): Use the SDK with AI assistants
- [AGENTS.md](https://docs.y.uno/AGENTS.md): Guidelines for AI agents

## API reference

- [Overview](https://docs.y.uno/reference/getting-started/api-reference-overview): How to use the API
- [Authentication](https://docs.y.uno/reference/getting-started/authentication): API keys and headers
- [Environments](https://docs.y.uno/reference/getting-started/api-environments): Sandbox and production URLs
- [Response codes](https://docs.y.uno/reference/getting-started/response-codes): Status codes and errors
- [OpenAPI (JSON)](https://docs.y.uno/openapi.json)
- [OpenAPI (YAML)](https://docs.y.uno/openapi.yaml)

## Legacy SDKs

> These SDKs are deprecated. Use the Yuno SDK for new integrations.

- [Choose integration](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/overview/choose-integration): Legacy SDK options
- [Migration guide](https://docs.y.uno/docs/yuno-sdk/migration/overview): Migrate to the Yuno SDK
- [Lite SDK](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/lite-web/payment): Legacy Lite integration
- [Seamless SDK](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/seamless-sdk/index): Legacy Seamless integration
- [Headless SDK](https://docs.y.uno/docs/sdks/headless-web/payment): Legacy Headless integration
